results.title: Results

interpretation.advantageous_improving: The patient shows a preference for advantageous stacks with progressive improvement across the session, suggesting good learning of risk modulation.
interpretation.advantageous_stable: The patient shows a consistent preference for advantageous stacks throughout the session.
interpretation.advantageous_declining: The patient shows a preference for advantageous stacks, though this trend weakens toward the end of the session.
interpretation.disadvantageous_improving: The patient shows a preference for disadvantageous stacks, but with progressive improvement suggesting ongoing learning.
interpretation.disadvantageous_stable: The patient shows a consistent preference for disadvantageous stacks, suggesting difficulty modulating risk.
interpretation.disadvantageous_declining: The patient shows a preference for disadvantageous stacks, with a trend that worsens across the session.
interpretation.neutral_improving: The patient shows no clear preference for advantageous or disadvantageous stacks, with progressive improvement during the session.
interpretation.neutral_stable: The patient shows no clear preference for advantageous or disadvantageous stacks throughout the session.
interpretation.neutral_declining: The patient shows no clear preference for advantageous or disadvantageous stacks, with performance that worsens toward the end.

results.disclaimer: This interpretation is indicative only and does not constitute a clinical diagnosis.
